notes.title: No more rats fix
notes.notes:
Boarding up air vents prevents rats from entering a level for a while, but because of a silly bug no more rats were being spawned when using planks. Fixed!

Also tweaked a bit the last patch, grabbing items works better. 

Keep playing, Kaiju Control Force!

notes.title: Super jump and slippery items fix
notes.notes:
Hello Kaiju Control Force!

This update fixes two minor but annoying bugs found by Laura (Hello Laura! And thank you a lot for telling us about these issues, even though we know there's one you are keeping for yourself because you think it makes the game easier) :D

[list]
[*] Players won't super-jump out of ladders anymore. If you stunned a rat while climbing down a ladder and then climbed up, you experienced an extra push that could make the player get to the platform above. Useful, but unexpected.
[*] If you are carrying an item and you collide with a rat, the item flies away. It was impossible to pick it up again unless you walked away and then back to it. 
[/list]
Thank you for playing! See you soon!

notes.title: Now working on Steamdeck!
notes.notes:
With this patch we fix a bug/feature, preventing players from climbing ladders further away from their bottom, ending up on the other side of the platform. Could be understood as a feature but nope. 

It's not as if we have never climbed ladders in the game, but when going down we usually never got to the very end, jumping out way before we reached the ground! Anyway, it's fixed now. 

AAAAAND we've added Linux support, whic[b]h means the game works on Steamdecks now[/b]! 

Keep the good work, Kaiju Control Force!

notes.title: First patch on its way!
notes.notes:
- In both the main menu and tutorial stage, X and Z keys where wrongly written in the back wall (which explains controls). 
- We are uploading a Linux version, hoping it will work on Steamdeck! :D

Keep the good work, Kaiju Control Force!
